business_problem: A leading US retailer wanted to identify risks such as counterfeit products and litigation before costly incidents occurred. Existing manual reviews and fragmented public data could not reliably surface risks across thousands of marketplace listings and retail locations.
solution_summary: KPMG built a predictive risk-monitoring system on Google Cloud that uses NLP and multiple machine-learning models to analyze public data, including product listings, reviews, pricing, and community information. KPMG Signals Repository harvests data from more than 55,000 sources and transforms structured and unstructured information into signals; ingestion functions preprocess and cleanse it before it is staged in Cloud Storage and stored in BigQuery. Models trained with Google Compute Engine, Cloud Natural Language, AutoML, and BERT analyze separate risk indicators, including review language and reviewer behavior. The system assigns risk scores, highlights suspicious product descriptions and prices, and provides supporting evidence through personalized Looker dashboards. The workflow also connects with the retailer's case-management system so teams can investigate flagged risks.

solution_components.name: KPMG Signals Repository
solution_components.role: Harvests public and private data sources and turns information into signals for risk prediction.

solution_components.name: Google Cloud Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the cloud foundation on which the retailer's predictive risk-monitoring system was deployed.

solution_components.name: Cloud Functions
solution_components.role: Runs serverless functions required to ingest and preprocess data.

solution_components.name: BigQuery
solution_components.role: Stores the ingested data lake used by the predictive risk system.

solution_components.name: Google Compute Engine
solution_components.role: Provides compute for training machine-learning models.

solution_components.name: Cloud Natural Language
solution_components.role: Supports NLP analysis of unstructured text used in risk signals.

solution_components.name: AutoML
solution_components.role: Trains machine-learning models used for retailer risk analysis.

solution_components.name: BERT
solution_components.role: Interprets text context for risk prediction using words on both sides of a term.

solution_components.name: Looker
solution_components.role: Displays scored risk factors and supporting evidence in team dashboards.

data_flow: Public product, review, pricing, and community data is harvested and preprocessed by KPMG Signals Repository and Cloud Functions, staged in Cloud Storage, and analyzed from BigQuery with NLP and ML models; scored risks and evidence appear in Looker and connect to case-management workflows.

E-commerce product listings, reviews, descriptions, and pricing
business_outcome: The retailer can proactively score more than a dozen business risks, identify suspicious products and potential litigation hotspots, and provide risk evidence to reviewers. KPMG completed the first implementation in four weeks.
